verdict.rationale: The documentation in the pack covers only the Microsoft Graph mail API for Microsoft mailboxes. Nothing shows Outlook adding Gmail or IMAP accounts alongside Microsoft 365 and working them from one place. One community comment hints at reading mailboxes across multiple Microsoft 365 orgs, and another mentions a user with Gmail and Outlook accounts, but neither affirms cross-provider account connection inside Outlook.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
